info.title: NTL Two-Stage Encoders: ModernBERT + DeBERTa
info.subtitle: Fine-tuned ModernBERT-large & DeBERTa-v3-large for 18-way LLM attribution
info.description:
# Name That LLM: two-stage encoder members (ModernBERT-large + DeBERTa-v3-large)

Two fine-tuned **18-way LLM-attribution classifiers** for the [Name That LLM](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/name-that-llm)
competition, plus the hashed n-gram member and the out-of-fold fusion weights. **Inference only, no training needed.**

Used in the public notebook [0.624 | When LLM Decoders Meet BERT Encoders](https://www.kaggle.com/code/nuridudak/0-624-when-llm-decoders-meet-bert-encoders),
where adding them to Nishant Dahal's 0.620 notebook gave **0.624 public LB**.

| folder / file | what it is | balanced accuracy (prompt-grouped 5-fold OOF, official train) |
|---|---|---|
| `modernbert/` | ModernBERT-large, full fine-tune, `AutoModelForSequenceClassification`, bf16 safetensors | **0.569** |
| `desklib/` | [desklib/ai-text-detector-v1.01](https://huggingface.co/desklib/ai-text-detector-v1.01) (DeBERTa-v3-large AI-text detector), full fine-tune | 0.523 |
| `light_members.npz` | hashed 4-view TF-IDF (char / word / shape / function-word) multinomial LR: column maps, IDF, weights | 0.468 |
| `fusion.json` | log-space fusion weights fitted out of fold | blend 0.592 |

## Quick start
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
path = "/kaggle/input/ntl-two-stage-encoders/modernbert"      # or .../desklib
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path)
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(path).cuda().eval()
labels = [model.config.id2label[i] for i in range(model.config.num_labels)]
```
Use `max_length=512`. fp16 autocast on a T4 is fine (both models together score ~2,700 passages in under 20 s).

## How they were trained
**Stage 1:** 2 epochs on **122,425 external passages** (15,446 prompt groups), class-weighted cross-entropy.
**Stage 2:** 2 epochs on the 2,699 official training passages at half the learning rate.

| setting | value |
|---|---|
| learning rate | stage 1: 2e-5 (ModernBERT, batch 32) / 2.8e-5 (desklib, batch 64); stage 2: 1e-5, batch 32 |
| schedule | 10 % linear warm-up, cosine decay, AdamW (weight decay 0.01), grad-clip 1.0 |
| precision / length | bf16 autocast, max 512 tokens, length-grouped batches; gradient checkpointing for DeBERTa |

Stage 1 alone (no official data seen) already scores 0.542 (ModernBERT) and 0.522 (desklib) on the official train.
The desklib checkpoint stores its encoder under `model.`; it was renamed to `deberta.` so the standard
`DebertaV2ForSequenceClassification` loads it; only the classification head is new.

## The external pool: merged from 45 public datasets
All public Name That LLM passage datasets available on 2026-10-22 were merged (1.27 M raw rows), then:
- **deduplicated** on lower-cased alphanumerics, keeping the raw generation over re-processed pool copies (so original typography survives);
- **style-filtered** to the competition format: one paragraph, 25 to 350 words, no markdown, code, or API logs;
- rows with **conflicting labels** across sources, **near duplicates** (MinHash Jaccard >= 0.8), exact copies of official
  passages, and one source with inconsistent provenance were **removed**.

843 of the passages are our own API-verified generations (the model the API reported matches the label).
